headlineDistanceKm.preferredForOverview: Use 177-195 km in overview until section geometry is reconciled.
notes: Västsverige overview says 177-195 km via 8 stages, with the shorter number for the core 8 stages and longer distance when taking route variations such as Rankåsleden.
Skaraborgsleder HTML says 195 km across 8 stages.
Skaraborgsleder 2009 overview PDF says 189 km, and its stage list uses stage 1 as 36 km and stage 8 as 31 km.
Current section inventory from the Västsverige overview sums to 175 km if stage 1=30 and stage 8=29, 177 km if stage 1=31 and stage 8=29, 189 km if stage 1=36 and stage 8=31.

fire: Official overview tells users to use designated fire pits only and extinguish fully.
Fire bans always override stored data; Västsverige notes fire bans always apply in nature reserves and may apply across the whole region during dry periods.
Stage-level reserve pages must be checked before importing fireplace/camping claims.
camping: Overview sources mention shelters and alternative accommodation, but no all-trail right-to-camp rule was found in phase 1.
Camping and shelter use must be checked per protected area, especially Tiveden National Park and Hökensås/Stora Röå/Håketjärnarna-type reserves.
water: Official pages repeatedly say lake and watercourse water is generally high quality but not continuously sampled; boil/filter when uncertain.
Västsverige overview recommends planning water stops and carrying extra water capacity.
Stage 5 and 6 pages warn of few safe/reliable water access points.
dogs: No whole-trail dog rule found in phase 1. AllTrails says dogs on lead for a short 2.3 km record, but this is not an official source; verify protected-area dog rules by section.
hunting: Official overview says to avoid hiking during moose hunting season.
accessAndConduct: No littering; use bins along the trail.
Off-road driving is prohibited in nature and on marked trails.
Show consideration to residents and stay on the trail.
Do not walk across fields with growing crops.
Fishing requires a fishing permit or landowner consent.

geometryPolicy: Prefer official Naturkartan GPX where it covers a full official stage and endpoints match stage order.

gapsContradictionsAndStaleSourceRisks.details: Current overview says 177-195 km; Skaraborgsleder HTML says 195 km; older overview PDF says 189 km; stage 1/stage 8 distances drive most of the difference.
Stage 1 appears as 30 km, 31 km, and 36 km across sources. Overview text mentions a split near Granvik. Section research must identify main/shortcut/alternate geometry.
Official stage lists use 17 km; Naturkartan/Smålandsleden GPX-backed record says 15.6 km and names direction Fagerhult-Hökensås.
Official stage is Fagerhult-Mullsjö/Hotel Mullsjö, 29 or 31 km. Naturkartan splits it into 20.6 km plus 9.2 km records.
Legacy sources use `Semesterbyn`; current pages use `First Camp Hökensås`. Keep both labels during research.
OSM wiki labels omit Röå/Hjo from stage names while distances match official stages; verify relation extent before import.
Several Skaraborgsleder PDFs are from 2014 or 2019. They are useful for service/route context but must be checked against current municipal/Naturkartan data.

nextResearchPlan: For each of the 8 official stages, spawn 6 independent agent lanes: official sources, route geometry, facilities, transit/access, field reports, and rules/safety/currentness.
Synthesize agent reports into one section research JSON per stage using the requested top-level schema.
After each synthesis, update research-progress.json and mark import readiness honestly.
